newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese construction sector seen buoyant.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese construction sector seen buoyant.

text.p: Portugal's construction sector grew in the third quarter and the trend should continue in the last three months of the year, the industry association AECOPS said in a report.

"The prospects of companies with regard to future production remain optimistic," it said. It added that the activity index hit its best level so far this year in September when capacity utilisation reached 75.7 percent.
Employment in the construction sector grew 1.9 percent in the third quarter compared with the same period last year, after falling sharply in the first quarter and remaining stagnant in the second.
Cement sales on the domestic market rose 3.1 percent in the three months to August, taking the gain over the first eight months of the year to 0.2 percent.
It said that Expo'98, the new bridge over the River Tagus and the railway to run over the existing bridge were the main motors of growth in the sector.
